triggers.text: Heard about Jackie. The door's open. No need to talk.
triggers.note: Jackie's loss, Viktor's own history with him, and V's last words about it.

triggers.text: You look bad on paper. Come by. Don't argue.
triggers.note: V's wounds, which fight it was, and the last fix he did.

triggers.text: Misty asked if you'd eat with us. I said you're busy. Were you?
triggers.note: Misty, the tarot, and the shop.

triggers.text: Card tonight at the old gym. Seat's free.
triggers.note: The gym, the result of V1, and any bet.

triggers.text: Some people can't sleep. I'm one of them. Tea's on.
triggers.note: V's insomnia, the hour, and Viktor's own habits.

triggers.text: You paid the 21,000. Fastest I've ever been paid. Don't let it go to your head.
triggers.note: The debt story and how much V had left.

triggers.text: I have a stethoscope and a theory. Meet me at the noodle alley. Bring your ears.
triggers.note: He wants V at the noodle alley to listen to chests with his stethoscope and test a theory.

triggers.text: Taco truck line in the Glen. Three people, one lie. Come hungry.
triggers.note: He is in the taco truck line in the Glen, where three people stand and one of them is lying.

triggers.text: Roadwork at dawn. Five minutes to warm up, then I don't wait. Courtyard by H10.
triggers.note: He is running roadwork at dawn in the courtyard by the clinic and will not wait.

triggers.text: Rooftop in the Glen. I brought a radio and a bad opinion. Come tell me I'm wrong.
triggers.note: He is on a rooftop in the Glen with a radio and wants V to tell him he is wrong about the music.

triggers.text: Misty swears by a tea stall by the bridge. I swear it is overpriced. Come settle it.
triggers.note: He wants V to settle an argument with Misty about an overpriced tea stall by the bridge.
